描述_EN: imperial robe of silk tapestry (kesi), woven in coloured silks and gold thread; some of the details have been executed with the brush. the collar and sleeves have bands of dragon designs on a fretted ground. lined with light blue silk damask. the lower border and sleeves are encircled with a striped pattern culminating in waves on which symbolical objects are floating. woven with medallions containing five-clawed dragons pursuing or grasping flaming jewels, the intervening space is covered with gold swastika fret overlaid with flying storks and bats, sprays of flowers and scrolled clouds.
描述_ZN: imperial robe of silk tapestry (kesi), woven in coloured silks and gold thread; some of the details have been executed with the brush. 领子和袖子上有带状的龙形图案，以花纹为底。 内衬为浅蓝色丝绸绫罗绸缎。 下边框和袖子上环绕着条纹图案，最后是象征性物体漂浮在上面的波浪。 织有五爪龙追赶或抓取火焰珠宝的徽章，中间的空间覆盖着金色的卍字纹，上面覆盖着飞翔的鹳鸟和蝙蝠、花束和卷云。
